glove-fa.label: Free-action gauntlets in the pack, none worn
glove-fa.explanation: A Warrior past depth 50 carries gauntlets of Free Action while having no free action of its own. The original never considers gloves as armour swaps and picks nothing; the correction picks the gauntlets and records the free-action swap flags.

before.raw:
native-c/gloves-205: starting...
SETUPSTEP profile
SETUP gloveslot=4 borg_fa=1 game_fa=1 game_known_fa=1
SETUP seed=1000 class=Warrior level=1 depth=30 hp=20/20
  gloves_eligible_for_armour_swap  MODE glove-fa
SWAPS armour_swap=0 value=-1 free_act=0
OUTCOME armour_swap=0 free_act=0

have-fa.label: Control: free action already worn
have-fa.explanation: With free-action gauntlets already worn, the carried pair is not worth a swap in either version — the free-action reward is gated on lacking it. The complete logs are byte-identical.
